body.name: ThetaHat
body.def: \(\widehat\Theta_{n,\alpha}\) is the union of each finite open price stratum and each breakpoint value retained by its own \(F_\kappa\)-based test \(\underline D_{F_\kappa,n}\le\rho_{n,\alpha}\), together with the separate terminal stratum \((K,+\infty)\) exactly when the \(F_\infty\)-based test \(\underline D_{F_\infty,n}\le\rho_{n,\alpha}\) holds.
